author: oyetewa
caption: Batana oil is trending… but here’s the truth: There’s no scientific evidence that batana oil treats hair loss or helps regrow hair. It hasn’t been studied in clinical trials, observational studies, or even lab models for alopecia. Yes, it’s been used traditionally in Central America and can be a great oil to seal moisture into your ends. BUT IT IS NOT a proven treatment for hair loss. And anyone telling you it is… is trying to scam you. If your goal is actual regrowth, first you need an actual diagnosis!! Then you need evidence-based treatments. See a dermatologist that specifically specializes in hair. Save this so you don’t fall for the hype.
